title: Hearty Croatian Meat Stew
description: A traditional Croatian dish featuring ground beef and pork, slow cooked in a rich and flavorful broth with a hint of ground nutmeg, this stew is perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: In a large pot or Dutch oven, cook the ground beef and pork over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until it is no longer pink, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot, and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the ground nutmeg, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth and tomato paste to the pot, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer the stew for 30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
Let the stew cool completely before refrigerating or freezing it for later use.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
